services.desc: Camping around the Lake Superior Circle Tour is one of the most popular, if not the most popular, way to enjoy Lake Superior. The tour is approximately 1,300 miles (2,092km) in length and can be completed in a few days to longer than a month. It all depends on you, the traveler. If camping is your primary reason for taking this trip, or just an added bonus, we have you covered. Our Lake Superior Circle Tour Campground List, within the Lake Superior Circle Tour Adventure Guide and available here for download, has all the campgrounds along the route. blurb: The Discover Geraldton Interpretive Centre is located in Geraldton in Ontario’s Superior Country. Situated in the heart of the municipality of Greenstone you’ll find this unique architecturally designed interpretive centre standing above Highway 11. The knowledgeable staff here can provide you helpful information about all of the communities within Greenstone.
